scope: All 21 eval scenarios in the two selected Corey folders; textual review only, not an execution or independent acceptance result. External claims are not verified by reading assertions.

cases.disposition: Evidence-first audit and schema extraction limitations are useful; context access is conditional and findings need measured support.
Inspect intent and technical evidence; ranking position alone does not establish a causal diagnosis or content-depth deficit.
Compare actual pre/post migration URLs and signals; do not promise recovery timing or redirect unrelated retired pages.
Parameterized products require observed duplicate and crawl evidence; large catalog size alone is not proof of a crawl-budget defect.
Inventory existing content and intent; age, absent clusters or author pages alone are not universal failures.
Preserve actual location identities and privacy; eligibility and local markup advice require current policy evidence.
Do not equate reported page load time with measured LCP/INP/CLS or infer a quantified ranking loss; verify current measurement definitions before advice.
Implementation and routing to another customer skill are excluded; any FAQ rich-result claim needs current eligibility verification.
Keep query/page baselines; reject title-only diagnosis, top-three comparison mandate, fixed 3-4 week timing and two-round stopping as audit gates.
Preserve locale/content distinctions and uncertainty; canonical advice requires actual signals and current primary guidance.
Preserve private address and real-location distinctions; no incentivized review execution or fabricated branches.
Preserve capacity qualifiers and supplied facts; description writing is outside read-only audit execution.
Text-only extraction cannot establish missing rendered schema; API availability and profile status require current evidence before recommendation.
Audience and buyer-task mapping are useful; fixed pillar counts, weighted scores and publishing cadence are optional planning hypotheses, not quality thresholds.
Inventory before consolidation or retirement; flat traffic does not prove that clustering is the cause or cure.
Adapt content to actual developer tasks and evidence; do not substitute audience stereotypes or invented demand for research.
Use declared constraints and transparent prioritization; 40/30/20/10 weights are not validated outcome predictions.
Hub/spoke mapping is optional; reject 3000-word and 8-15-spoke requirements as audit gates.
Keep a single customer-facing audit entrypoint; do not execute another skill or write a full article automatically.
Exclude unverified vendor multipliers from recommendations and outcomes; a single observational study does not establish the best format for this customer.
Distribution is contextual planning, not audit execution; exclude fixed 60/30/10 allocation, editing/title quotas and launch/social skill routing.
